SELECT r.id, rev.id AS revisionId, r.venue_id AS venueId, r.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, s.name AS sportName, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(b.start_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR), '%Y-%m') AS visitMonth, rev.body, rev.overall_score AS overallScore, rev.court_score AS courtScore, rev.environment_score AS environmentScore, rev.service_score AS serviceScore, rev.anonymous, r.created_at AS createdAt, rr.id AS replyId, rrr.body AS replyBody, rr.content_status AS replyContentStatus, rrr.moderation_status AS replyModerationStatus, rrr.created_at AS replyCreatedAt FROM s_venue_review r JOIN s_venue_review_revision rev ON rev.id = r.public_revision_id JOIN s_booking b ON b.id = r.booking_id JOIN s_sport_type s ON s.id = r.sport_type_id LEFT JOIN s_venue_review_reply rr ON rr.review_id = r.id AND rr.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' LEFT JOIN s_venue_review_reply_revision rrr ON rrr.id = rr.public_revision_id AND rrr.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' WHERE r.venue_id = #{venueId} AND r.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' AND rev.overall_score = #{score}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_venue_review_tag_rel rel WHERE rel.revision_id = rev.id AND rel.tag_id = #{tagId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_venue_review_media m WHERE m.revision_id = rev.id AND m.moderation_status = 'APPROVED')
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, AVG(rev.overall_score) AS overallScore, AVG(rev.court_score) AS courtScore, AVG(rev.environment_score) AS environmentScore, AVG(rev.service_score) AS serviceScore FROM s_venue_review r JOIN s_venue_review_revision rev ON rev.id = r.public_revision_id WHERE r.venue_id = #{venueId} AND r.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM s_venue_review r JOIN s_venue_review_revision rev ON rev.id = r.public_revision_id JOIN s_venue_review_tag_rel rel ON rel.revision_id = rev.id JOIN s_review_tag t ON t.id = rel.tag_id WHERE r.venue_id = #{venueId} AND r.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY reviewCount DESC, t.id

SELECT r.id, rev.id AS revisionId, r.venue_id AS venueId, r.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, s.name AS sportName, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(b.start_at, INTERVAL 8 HOUR), '%Y-%m') AS visitMonth, rev.body, rev.overall_score AS overallScore, rev.court_score AS courtScore, rev.environment_score AS environmentScore, rev.service_score AS serviceScore, rev.anonymous, r.created_at AS createdAt, rr.id AS replyId, rrr.body AS replyBody, rr.content_status AS replyContentStatus, rrr.moderation_status AS replyModerationStatus, rrr.created_at AS replyCreatedAt FROM s_venue_review r JOIN s_venue_review_revision rev ON rev.id = r.public_revision_id JOIN s_booking b ON b.id = r.booking_id JOIN s_sport_type s ON s.id = r.sport_type_id LEFT JOIN s_venue_review_reply rr ON rr.review_id = r.id LEFT JOIN s_venue_review_reply_revision rrr ON rrr.id = rr.current_revision_id WHERE r.venue_id = #{venueId} AND r.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 100

mapper.select: SELECT 'REVIEW' AS contentType, NULL AS replyId, r.id AS reviewId, rev.id AS revisionId, r.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, rev.body, pub.body AS publicBody, r.content_status AS contentStatus, rev.moderation_status AS moderationStatus, rev.overall_score AS overallScore, rev.created_at AS submittedAt FROM s_venue_review r JOIN s_venue_review_revision rev ON rev.id = r.current_revision_id LEFT JOIN s_venue_review_revision pub ON pub.id = r.public_revision_id JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = r.venue_id WHERE (rev.moderation_status = 'PENDING' OR r.content_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'HIDDEN')) AND r.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'REVIEW_REPLY' AS contentType, rr.id AS replyId, rr.review_id AS reviewId, rrr.id AS revisionId, rr.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, rrr.body, pub.body AS publicBody, rr.content_status AS contentStatus, rrr.moderation_status AS moderationStatus, NULL AS overallScore, rrr.created_at AS submittedAt FROM s_venue_review_reply rr JOIN s_venue_review_reply_revision rrr ON rrr.id = rr.current_revision_id LEFT JOIN s_venue_review_reply_revision pub ON pub.id = rr.public_revision_id JOIN s_venue_review r ON r.id = rr.review_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = rr.venue_id WHERE (rrr.moderation_status = 'PENDING' OR rr.content_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'HIDDEN')) AND rr.content_status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY moderationStatus DESC, submittedAt ASC, revisionId ASC LIMIT 100
